name: Private FPS Pro
description: Private FPS unlocker, bot recorder, frame stepper and swift clicks for GD 2.2 (Android).

fps_target.name: Target FPS
fps_target.description: Target frame rate when the unlocker is enabled.

bot_recording.name: Bot is recording
bot_recording.description: Internal flag set by the hub. Toggle from the in-game menu.

bot_playing.name: Bot is playing
bot_playing.description: Internal flag set by the hub. Toggle from the in-game menu.

ignore_inputs.name: Ignore physical inputs while playing
ignore_inputs.description: Drop player taps while the bot is replaying a macro.

frame_stepper.name: Frame stepper
frame_stepper.description: Pause gameplay updates and advance one frame at a time.

cbf_boost.name: CBF boost
cbf_boost.description: Click-burst factor for grouping near-simultaneous inputs.

swift_clicks.name: Swift click count
swift_clicks.description: How many synthetic clicks per second when swift is on.
